shots.title: Vienna from above
shots.kicker: Aerial · city scale · outline © OpenStreetMap contributors
shots.idea: Open on the whole city seen from above. A heat map builds up district by district and shows where Vienna overheats in summer. The camera settles on the dense inner west around Westbahnhof, our case study.
shots.data: Heat map: surface temperature or heat-vulnerability data (source to confirm)

shots.title: Westbahnhof: sun & shade, summer and winter
shots.idea: The zoom lands on the district around Westbahnhof as an isometric model, with the Raumpark above it: a branching deck that grows along the streets. Two days run as time-lapses: 21 June, with the sun high on a long arc and a short shadow under the deck, then 21 December, with the sun low on a short arc and the deck's shadow stretching far across streets and courtyards. Both day arcs stay visible, so the difference reads at once.
shots.camera: Fixed isometric · time-lapse 21 June, then 21 December
shots.graphics: Summer and winter sun arcs · deck shadow
shots.data: Sun position for Vienna on 21 June and 21 December (calculated) · 3D model of the area

shots.title: Westbahnhof: heat without / with Raumpark
shots.idea: Same view of the district, now as heat. First without the Raumpark: the paved streets and the station forecourt glow warm red, the courtyards are milder. Then the Raumpark fades in and the heat map shifts: under and around the deck the ground turns cooler blue. Same view, same scale, so the difference reads at a glance.
shots.camera: Fixed isometric; without → Raumpark fades in → with
shots.graphics: Blue → red heat map · semi-transparent deck
shots.data: Surface temperature or heat-stress simulation with and without the deck (to confirm)

shots.title: Westbahnhof: wind
shots.idea: Same camera, new layer: wind particles run through the streets and over the deck. Channelled jets and sheltered corners become visible, and the deck level turns out windier than the street.
shots.camera: Same isometric view, gentle push-in to street level
shots.data: CFD results or schematic flow (to decide)

shots.title: Window & model, side by side
shots.idea: Starts on the overview of the district with the Raumpark. The deck turns transparent and the camera pushes in on one window of a Gründerzeit house below it. Then the view out of that window fills the screen, with light and shade moving through the room over the day, while a small isometric sun study in the corner shows the same moment with the window marked. Both run in sync, so the abstract model meets everyday experience.
shots.camera: Overview → deck fades to transparent → push-in on one window → full-screen window view with a synced model inset
shots.graphics: Transparent deck · window highlight · model inset · shared clock
shots.data: Same sun data · one reference flat / window

shots.title: Use: culture
shots.idea: The whole deck in isometric view, every volume transparent. The culture volumes fade in from transparent to full colour: pavilions and event space at the western intersection.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner
shots.graphics: Use colour · volumes fading in · plan
shots.data: Programme and capacity of the culture zone

shots.title: Use: health & wellbeing
shots.idea: Same view, next use: the health & wellbeing volumes (sport, pool, wellbeing) fade in on the eastern platforms, the rest stays transparent.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner
shots.graphics: Use colour · volumes fading in · plan

shots.title: Use: residential
shots.idea: Same view: the residential volumes, the tallest boxes on the deck, fade in on the central platform and show that people can live up here too.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner
shots.graphics: Use colour · volumes fading in · plan

shots.title: Use: green areas
shots.idea: Same view: the low green volumes fade in along the arms of the deck as planted areas. It hands over directly to the solar diagram that follows.
shots.camera: Same isometric view of the whole deck, one use in colour, plan in the corner
shots.graphics: Use colour · volumes fading in · plan
shots.data: Planting concept, green area in m²

shots.title: Circulation
shots.idea: A line builds up through the district: it starts on the street, climbs a stair and lift core at one pylon, runs along the deck's arms past each use (health, culture, green areas, housing) and comes back down another core. The cores at every pylon show how each part of the Raumpark connects to the street below.
shots.camera: Same isometric view, the route draws itself with a moving point
shots.graphics: Route line · stair cores · use nodes
shots.data: Access points, stairs / lifts and main routes (from the research team)

shots.title: Greenery & solar income
shots.kicker: Diagram · heat map on the deck
shots.idea: A diagram over the whole deck: a heat map of how much sun each part receives over the year, with the use volumes casting their shade. From it follows where planting thrives, where shade-loving planting belongs, and where PV pays off, with the share of each shown as bars.
shots.camera: Top-down / isometric diagram, heat map sweeps in
shots.graphics: Solar heat map · legend · share bars · PV
shots.data: Yearly sun on the deck (calculated) · planting and PV assumptions

shots.title: Layers & key figures
shots.idea: The model separates into its layers (city, structure, deck, use volumes) while the key figures count up. A closing image that also works as a still for print.
